name: yayaw-table-chart
title: Yayaw Table Chart
description: Optional chart display mode for YaYaw Table (vertical and horizontal bars, line, area, bars and line, donut, funnel and number), rendered with shadcn/ui charts (Recharts) and an SVG funnel. Pass `chartRenderer` to `displayModeRenderers` and add "chart" to `table.displayModes`.
